QuestInfo.name: The Demon's Lair 1
QuestInfo.0: What does Takeda Shingen want? It's time for battle!
QuestInfo.1: Shingen wants you to secure an entryway into the temple. Defeat 200 low-ranking Oda warriors.
QuestInfo.2: You cleared out the low-level Oda warriors. The entrance should be secure.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 7,261,077 Can proceed to The Demon's Lair 2 quest

0.0: You've accomplished tremendous things. Without you here in Maple World, I don't know that we would have the fighting chance we do. That's why the job at hand is one I can entrust to you alone.
0.1: I want you to charge ahead of our forces and create a diversion. Only you are strong enough to lead our entry. Will you do it?

yes.0: Excellent! I might as well spread tidings of victory right now! Best of luck to you. Charge through the Honnou-ji main gates and go wild!

no.0: You're the only one for the job. Your rejection is a blow straight to the hair.

yes.0: Splendid performance! And not a hair out of place! How do you do it?

default.0: Defeat 200 of the Oda Army's low-ranking warriors and secure an entry path for the allies.
